PART I : SECTION (I) — GENERAL

Government Notifications

1A - PG 6860 - 154 (09/2024) This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

Forest Conservation Ordinance

THE order under sub section 3(1) that has to be read with sub section 4(1) of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) No. 16 of 1907, as amended by Act No. 13 of 1966 (reprint), No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009.

The Order

By virtue of the powers vested in me under sub section 3(1) that has to be read with sub section 4(1) of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) No. 16 of 1907, as amended by Act No. 13 of 1966 (reprint), No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, I, Minister of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation do by this Order declare the state lands of the extent 1,600.0 hectares bounded by the limits set forth in the Schedules 1,2,3,4,5,6,7 & 8 hereto as Puwarasankulam 2 Reserved Forest from 29th day of August 2024.

Pavithra Wanniarachchi, Minister of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation.

Ministry of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation, No. 07, Hector Kobbekaduwa Mawatha, Colombo 07,29th day of August. 2024.

EOG 09 - 0039/1

FOREST CONSERVATION ORDINANCE

Notification

By virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 63 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) No. 16 of 1907, as amended by Act No. 13 of 1966 (reprint), No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, I do by this notification notify that the Puwarasankulam 2 Reserved Forest mentioned in the above order is subjected to the sole control of the Conservator General of Forests.

Pavithra Wanniarachchi, Minister of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation.

Ministry of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation, No. 07, Hector Kobbekaduwa Mawatha, Colombo 07,29th day of August. 2024.
